services.desc: Both our Westfield and North Adams breweries are the perfect venue for your next private gathering. Enjoy our craft beer and outdoor patio at our conveniently located private event space in Westfield, MA. Perfect for holiday parties, wedding receptions, birthday parties and any special occasion. With room to host 20 to 400 people, our Westfield Taproom is a fully versatile event space with multiple rooms to match any party size & need. You can access our beautiful Green Room with a conference table, cozy fireplace nook, & relaxed seating. services.desc: Bright Ideas Brewing proudly announces the opening of its second brewing space and taproom, situated in the vibrant heart of Westfield, Massachusetts. Building upon the success of its initial brewery and taproom established in North Adams on the MASS MoCA Campus in April 2016, Bright Ideas Brewing is excited to join the beer established community in Westfield. Our company stance on craft beer is simple; every pint should focus on bringing together the community of people, beer, and community.
